summary: Species initialization followed by the finite ordered spectral scan.

identity.direction: Declared scientific input ports in one mapping -> completed scientific state and declared artifacts
identity.definition: Species initialization followed by the finite ordered spectral scan. inputs mapping: deck=None,scenario="default",controls=None,par=None; operator units/defaults apply. Scientific graph nodes reuse the declared native numerical relations; a fused native implementation may execute them in one process. Controlled glue only schedules, carries state and projects results. The public Python wrapper accepts one inputs mapping; each listed scientific port is an entry of that mapping, with required/default status from the actual underlying callable.
identity.model: Uniform magnetized, nonrelativistic charged Gaussian species with optional gyrotropic loss-cone mixture; B0 along signed z and k=(kx,0,kz).
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: All nodes consume compatible scientific predecessor state.
Ordinary dependencies are acyclic; feedback, when present, has the stated finite schedule.
Mode selection is an explicitly defined algorithm; physical uniqueness is not asserted.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.constraints: S>=1; charged q!=0,m>0,n>=0 with first n>0,Tparallel/Tperp/alpha>0,Delta in[0,1],abs(vd/c)<1; finite representable binary64. None loads the scenario deck.

inputs.name: scenario
inputs.constraints: One of default,beammode,coldplasma,dispersionsurface,es1d_beam,es3d_losscone,loss_cone_mirror; each retains its own source setup.

inputs.name: controls
inputs.description: Explicit overrides after scenario setup and before initialization.
inputs.units: mixed; B0 T,wg0 omega/wcs1,angles degree,k coordinates k*cwp
inputs.constraints: Only iem,N,J,sp,wg0,B0,ipa,ipb,iloga,ilogb,pa1,pa2,dpa,pb1,pb2,dpb,iout. iem0/1,J4/8/12,Ninteger>=0,sp0/1,iout1/2; B0,dpa,dpb nonzero; scan pairs(1,1),(2,2),(3,3),(4,4),(1,2),(3,4). None preserves scenario defaults; default scenario uses N3,J8,B0=1e-7,sp0,wg0=1.5+.01i,ipa=ipb3,linear pa0:.01:1,iout1.

inputs.name: par
inputs.description: Independent six-coordinate state override, without implicit synchronization between polar and Cartesian entries.
inputs.constraints: Entries1..4 are normalized k,angle,kz,kx. Entries5..6 retain source slots; no new scanned physics is inferred. None preserves scenario setup.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Completed NativeResult.state with compatible native scientific carrier and typed artifacts.
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native stored dimensions are preserved; trailing singleton axes may be omitted while interior singleton axes remain and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: ww
outputs.description: Computed dimensional frequencies ordered by descending imaginary part at each point.
outputs.shape: (npa,npb,nw) for nw>1; (npa,npb) for nw=1; conceptual axes are scan a, scan b, frequency
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native stored dimensions are preserved; trailing singleton axes may be omitted while interior singleton axes remain and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: kxx
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native stored dimensions are preserved; trailing singleton axes may be omitted while interior singleton axes remain and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: kzz
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native stored dimensions are preserved; trailing singleton axes may be omitted while interior singleton axes remain and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: par
outputs.description: Updated independent six-entry coordinate carrier; one-dimensional Python input is serialized as a row, and native coordinate assignments preserve its orientation.
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: wg
outputs.description: Final source guess restored according to row continuation, not necessarily the last eigenfrequency.
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native stored dimensions are preserved; trailing singleton axes may be omitted while interior singleton axes remain and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

supported: Explicit DAG composition with bounded native feedback where declared.
excluded: Physical branch uniqueness, arbitrary changes to source state, visual acceptance and unbounded root searches.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; incomplete or inconsistent state may raise KeyError or a native indexing/domain error. No silent physical-model substitution.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError records unavailable/failed/timed-out Octave execution. source_output additionally raises SourceOutputError carrying the result and receipt computed so far when its caught scientific terminal fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Eigen/interpolation/selection native failure is observable; no failed root is converted to a successful mode. This operator does not certify global root convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed NativeResult carries immutable state and receipt. source_output failures expose partial artifacts through exception.result; other failed native calls do not promise a completed scientific state.

example.description: Requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 for the native execution path; this macOS execution is NOT_RUN.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk import magnetized as m, workflows as w
deck=np.array([[1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0],[-1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0.]])
controls=dict(B0=1e-7,N=1,J=4,sp=0,iem=1,iout=2,ipa=3,ipb=3,iloga=0,ilogb=0,pa1=.2,pa2=.4,dpa=.1)
eq=m.initialize_equilibrium(deck,controls=controls,par=[.2,0,.2,0,0,0])
r=w.solve_dispersion({'deck':deck,'controls':controls,'par':[.2,0,.2,0,0,0]})
assert np.isfinite(r.state['ww']).all()

execution.mode: Sequential scientific composition; fused native point relations preserve the same order.
execution.ordering: Listed DAG order; bounded source index feedback is explicit for scan and polarization.
branches: iem selects electromagnetic or electrostatic matrix.
sp selects dense full spectrum or sparse targeted eigenvalues.
iout2 EM owns field reconstruction; iout1 retains frequency-only output.
execution.state_ownership: Caller owns input mapping; each native invocation owns isolated scratch state. Return immutable NativeResult with completed state; no source checkout or hidden mutable global scientific state.
execution.failure_propagation: Python/native/domain/timeout failures propagate. source_output raises SourceOutputError retaining partial terminal artifacts. original_program returns program_completed/program_error separately from transport status; a false completion flag is never scientific success.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
